description_en: Deactivates blackhole filtering that is triggered on an instance
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo modify-blackhole-status --blackhole-status undo --instance-id ddoscoo-cn-mp91j1ao0000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyBlackholeStatus

parameters.description_en: The action that you want to perform on the instance. Set the value to **undo**, which indicates that you want to deactivate blackhole filtering.
